notes: V120 Life and World Rebirth: original consistent cached pixel-art props across woodland, desert, snow, coast, fen and wasteland; homestead buildings, coop, sheds, garden and jetty; cohesive wildlife silhouettes and hand-gripped axe/pickaxe/shovel/torch/rod/net with animation phases. Large boulders require a pickaxe and multiple strikes and break into persistent small rocks; hands may collect only those fragments. A starter pickaxe can be made from fallen wood and twigs without requiring mined stone. Haigen now chooses mining, woodwork, cooking, fishing, gardening, nature study/catch-release, building path lanterns/signs, and exploration jobs beyond collecting, with actionable notebook goals and safe travel. Keeps V119 chunky movement and wardrobe, V116 readable dialogue, local saves, iPad input, companions, Silent Pond and original Ember. Pixel-art pass uses code-generated matching visuals; separately generated high-detail concept atlases still require import/cropping. iPad Safari full-playtest pending.
